name: PowerShell
description: Runs an inline PowerShell script or a .ps1 file.

args.name: script
args.label: Script
args.description: Inline PowerShell to run. Mutually exclusive with 'file'.

args.name: file
args.label: Script file
args.description: Path to a .ps1 file, relative to the task's working directory.

args.name: shell
args.label: Shell
args.description: 'pwsh' - the only value this task accepts. A task that wants cmd wants a 'run:' task.

args.name: errorActionPreference
args.label: ErrorActionPreference
args.description: Prepended as $ErrorActionPreference. 'stop' makes a failing cmdlet fail the task - without it a cmdlet error only writes to stderr and the task still passes.

args.name: progressPreference
args.label: ProgressPreference
args.description: Prepended as $ProgressPreference. Left at 'silentlyContinue' so progress bars do not spray control characters into the log.

args.name: failOnStderr
args.label: Fail on stderr
args.description: Fail the task if anything is written to stderr, even when it exits zero.

args.name: ignoreExitCode
args.label: Ignore exit code
args.description: Report a non-zero exit without failing the task.
